name: 20735 · Clinton, MD
findings: ZIP 20735 (Clinton) has 219 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20735 (Clinton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
